title: MiniMax H3 Image
summary: Generate image with MiniMax H3 Image
description: MiniMax H3 Image — MiniMax's newest image model: photoreal detail, exact text on signs, menus and posters, and edits from plain instructions. Text-to-image, plus editing and multi-reference composition from up to 10 reference images, at 2K or 4K in any shape from 1:3 to 3:1. Billing: 34 credits per image at 2K, 100 at 4K, plus 12 per reference image (each one, per generated image). No seed, negative prompt or transparent background.
pricing_text: Pricing: 34 credits per generation (varies by resolution).

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. "auto" (default) keeps the first reference image's shape when editing, or lets the model pick a shape from the prompt for text-to-image.

num_images.description: Number of images to generate, all made in one request. Each image returned is billed; one the model's safety check withholds is not.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate, or of the edit to apply to the reference images. The model expands the prompt before it renders. Write `@handle` to cast a character: a BudgetPixel AI influencer or one of your own ([`GET /v1/characters`](/api-reference/characters/list-characters-you-can-cast)).

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 10) for image editing and multi-reference composition. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-image. Each reference image bills 12 credits per generated image; images over 2 megapixels are scaled down to 2 megapixels first.

size.description: Output size: 2K is about 4 MP (2048x2048, or 2720x1536 at 16:9) and bills 34 credits per image; 4K is about 16 MP (4096x4096) and bills 100.
